# CBRE 

> CBRE is the world's largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, operating in over 100 countries. This file maps the highest-priority pages on cbre.com: corporate information, service lines, property-type and industry expertise, local offices, and featured properties.

CBRE's services are organized into core lines — Plan, Lease & Occupy; Manage Properties & Portfolios; Design & Build; Invest, Finance & Value; Transform Business Outcomes; and Energy & Sustainability — plus two cross-cutting views, by property type and by industry. The Offices section lists local and affiliate market pages; Properties lists featured listings.

## Company

- [Global Commercial Real Estate Services](https://www.cbre.com/): CBRE is the global leader in commercial real estate services and investments.
- [About Us](https://www.cbre.com/about-us): We bring the diverse knowledge of our people, clients, and partners to realize potential in every business and every person.
- [Career & Job Opportunities](https://www.cbre.com/careers): career opportunities with CBRE, the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment.
- [Insights & Research](https://www.cbre.com/insights): insights and trends in the real estate industry with CBRE.
- [Commercial Property Services](https://www.cbre.com/services): Unlock the value in every dimension of your real estate. Using deep insights and global expertise, we create real estate strategies that drive superior business outcomes.
- [Find a CBRE Employee](https://www.cbre.com/people): CBRE to find the best office spaces and experienced staff near you. Start your property journey with us today.
- [Commercial Real Estate Broker Finder](https://www.cbre.com/people/brokers): Find your CBRE commercial real estate broker, leasing agent, or tenant rep by geography, service, and property type.

## Services — Plan, Lease & Occupy

- [Plan, Lease & Occupy](https://www.cbre.com/services/plan-lease-and-occupy): As the #1 advisory and transactions firm in the world, CBRE offers unique insight, experience, and solutions to serve the needs of occupiers and owners.
- [Experience by Industrious](https://www.cbre.com/services/plan-lease-and-occupy/experience-services): Experience by Industrious combines CBRE's global real estate expertise with Industrious hospitality to deliver measurable, performance-driven workplace experiences — from amenities to food & beverage and beyond.
- [Flexible Office Space Solutions](https://www.cbre.com/services/plan-lease-and-occupy/flexible-office-space): Flexible Office Space that is hybrid & decentralized is critical to the workplace of the future. Let CBRE Agile Solutions help your approach to a new flexible office.
- [Lease Administration](https://www.cbre.com/services/plan-lease-and-occupy/lease-administration): Gain competitive advantage through vital portfolio and asset-level reporting from the largest global provider of lease administration services.
- [Expense Management Solutions](https://www.cbre.com/services/plan-lease-and-occupy/lease-administration/expense-management-solutions): Identify and recover cost saving opportunities deep within a leasing portfolio.
- [Lease Accounting](https://www.cbre.com/services/plan-lease-and-occupy/lease-administration/lease-accounting): We equip companies for optimum decision-making by guiding real estate teams through the practical steps and actions required to collect, store and manage real estate data.
- [Organizational Change & Transformation](https://www.cbre.com/services/plan-lease-and-occupy/organizational-change-and-transformation): We enable leaders, teams, and organizations to achieve outcomes, improve performance and create a culture of continuous improvement to effectively manage change.
- [Organizational Change Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/plan-lease-and-occupy/organizational-change-and-transformation/organizational-change-management): We focus on performance, and help you manage and sustain change.
- [Organizational Design](https://www.cbre.com/services/plan-lease-and-occupy/organizational-change-and-transformation/organizational-design): We focus on enhancing the skills of your leaders and creating high performing teams ready to lead and support your transformation.
- [Organizational Development](https://www.cbre.com/services/plan-lease-and-occupy/organizational-change-and-transformation/organizational-development): We focus on enhancing the skills of your leaders and creating high performing teams ready to lead and support your transformation.
- [Portfolio Strategy](https://www.cbre.com/services/plan-lease-and-occupy/portfolio-strategy): Optimize your real estate portfolio with CBRE's expert strategy services. Maximize efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance performance.
- [Site Selection & Location Strategy](https://www.cbre.com/services/plan-lease-and-occupy/site-selection-and-location-strategy): Location drastically impacts operating and financial performance. CBRE’s unmatched market expertise helps us evaluate critical location decisions to power superior outcomes.
- [Transaction Services | Commercial Lease & Sublease Professionals](https://www.cbre.com/services/plan-lease-and-occupy/transaction-services): CBRE draws on unrivalled data, analytics and technology, as well as the expertise of our teams around the world, to design and deliver a corporate real estate strategy.
- [Workplace Solutions](https://www.cbre.com/services/plan-lease-and-occupy/workplace-solutions): We deliver workplace solutions from strategy to change, providing competitive advantage in scale, unified products and services, and an user-driven approach to inspiring workplaces.

## Services — Manage Properties & Portfolios

- [Commercial Property and Portfolio Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios): CBRE manages every aspect of your real estate, from accounting and operations to sustainability and energy management.
- [Distressed Assets & Optimization Practice](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/distressed-assets-optimization-practice): We offer lenders of distressed assets comprehensive, quantifiable, value-add services, and creative techniques to generate measurable results.
- [Integrated Facilities Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/facilities-management): CBRE is the global leader in facilities management solutions, providing cost effective, sector specialized expertise and innovative FM technology.
- [Financial Services Facilities Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/facilities-management/financial-services-facilities-management): Implement a globally consistent facilities management experience to every client while safeguarding your brand.
- [FM Technology](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/facilities-management/fm-technology): Optimize your facilities with CBRE’s FM technology solutions to reduce costs, enhance employee experiences and improve sustainability with AI and IoT.
- [Healthcare Facilities Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/facilities-management/healthcare-facilities-management): Creating measurably superior client outcomes by improving patient experiences through safe, engaging and high-performing environments of care.
- [Industrial & Logistics Facilities Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/facilities-management/industrial-and-logistics-facilities-management): Achieve measurably superior facilities management outcomes across all your Industrial and & Logistics environments.
- [Infrastructure, Defense & Public Enterprise Facilities Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/facilities-management/infrastructure-defense-and-public-enterprise-facilities-management): Tackle capital projects, improve operations and plan for the future of your essential infrastructure.
- [Life Sciences Facilities Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/facilities-management/life-sciences-facilities-management): Unlock superior facilities management outcomes across your labs, manufacturing space and critical environments.
- [Operations and Maintenance](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/facilities-management/operations-and-maintenance): CBRE's expert engineering and hard services, powered by the world's largest FM workforce, deliver superior outcomes with optimized operations & maintenance.
- [Retail & Multi-Site Facilities Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/facilities-management/retail-multisite-facilities-management): CBRE’s agile and flexible service delivery model—purpose-built for retail and multisite clients—reduces complexity, drives cost savings and provides greater insight into facility performance, enabling intelligent and sustainable growth.
- [Sector Solutions](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/facilities-management/sector-solutions): Build resilience and value for your facilities with CBRE's expert, sector specialized FM solutions tailored to your portfolio's complex needs.
- [Tech-driven Facilities Management Solutions](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/facilities-management/tech-driven-facilities-management-solutions): Unlock the power of technology in facilities management with CBRE's innovative solutions. Discover how data-driven insights and AI-powered tools can optimize your FM operations and drive business results.
- [Tech, Media & Telecom Facilities Management | CBRE](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/facilities-management/telecommunication-media-and-technology-facilities-management): Offering integrated facilities management solutions for telecommunications, media &and technology companies at every stage.
- [Three Engines Shaping the Future of Facilities Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/facilities-management/three-engines-shaping-the-future-of-facilities-management): CBRE delivers facilities management with a model built for today’s pace of change.
- [Workplace Experience](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/facilities-management/workplace-experience): Elevate your workplace with CBRE's FM Workplace Experience services, including cleaning, amenities and employee experience, to reduce costs & risks boost productivity.
- [Workplace Experience Services](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/facilities-management/workplace-experience-services): Transform your workplace into a destination of choice through people-centric, technology-enabled experience services to increase employee wellness and engagement, optimize performance and deliver meaningful workspace insights.
- [Real Estate Fund Administration and Property Accounting](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/fund-and-property-accounting): Providing property to fund-level accounting, reporting, and administration solutions that optimize our clients’ operating models, allowing them to focus on their investment strategies that drive superior returns.
- [Landlord Leasing](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/landlord-leasing): CBRE’s Investor Leasing experts develop tailored, comprehensive marketing and leasing strategies to create value across all commercial real estate asset classes.
- [CBRE Calibre Creative Group](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/landlord-leasing/calibre-creative-group): As an in-house commercial real estate marketing agency, CBRE Calibre Creative Group delivers award-winning, full-spectrum property marketing support to the top projects in CBRE’s leasing portfolio.
- [Federal Lessor Advisory Group](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/landlord-leasing/federal-lessor-advisory-group): We navigate every dimension of the federal leasing landscape to drive value for your real estate.
- [Occupancy Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/occupancy-management): CBRE’s Occupancy Management platform brings together subject matter experts focused on providing the best solutions to improve portfolio insights.
- [Property Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/property-management): CBRE property management services incorporate industry best practices and real-time data to improve building operational performance.
- [Global Premier](https://www.cbre.com/services/manage-properties-and-portfolios/property-management/global-premier): Global Premier elevates property management across every dimension to realize peak performance in exceptional properties worldwide.

## Services — Design & Build

- [Design & Build](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build): CBRE examines every aspect of your business or investment strategy to plan, design, develop, and deliver real estate.
- [Buildings & Systems](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/buildings-and-systems): Design and commission all aspects of your building, including systems, envelope and structure using the latest facilities best practices.
- [Construction Risk Services](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/construction-risk-services): CBRE’s Construction Risk Services team guides investors and lenders through the complex process of construction financing, from pre- to post-construction.
- [Cost Advisory](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/cost-advisory): CBRE’s Cost Consultancy practice is a dynamic group of solutions-oriented professionals relentlessly focused on superior outcomes for clients.
- [Move & Decommissioning](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/move-and-decommission): CBRE provides a full spectrum of decommissioning solutions; from furniture removal and brokerage to facility repair and low voltage removal.
- [Project & Program Management Office (PMO)](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/project-and-program-management): Deliver projects seamlessly with an integrated team that manages everything from schedules and budgets to the entire construction process.
- [Data Center Project Services](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/project-and-program-management/data-center-project-services): Delivering your critical data center projects through end-to-end services with global alignment and local delivery.
- [Education Project & Program Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/project-and-program-management/education-project-and-program-management): We provide a customized approach to managing school construction and renovation projects and programs.
- [Government Project & Program Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/project-and-program-management/government-project-and-program-management): A strategic approach to project and program management services for government environments.
- [Atlanta-Fulton County Public Library System](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/project-and-program-management/government-project-and-program-management/fulton-county): CBRE Heery, Inc. and H.J. Russell (the project team) formed a joint venture to provide program management services for the Fulton County Library System’s Capital Improvement Program in two phases.
- [Federal Center South Building](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/project-and-program-management/government-project-and-program-management/general-services-administration-federal-building): For this ambitious project, we provided construction management agency services, energy modeling/energy analysis, LEED support and full commissioning services.
- [Healthcare Project & Program Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/project-and-program-management/healthcare-project-and-program-management): Delivering expertise and advice to healthcare owners and occupiers across the continuum of capital planning and projects.
- [Georgia Regents University Medical Center](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/project-and-program-management/healthcare-project-and-program-management/georgia-regents-university-medical-center): Our team was retained to design an outpatient Oncology Center of Excellence to be located adjacent to the existing Medical College of Georgia Cancer Research Center.
- [Life Sciences Project & Program Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/project-and-program-management/life-sciences-project-and-program-management): From initial planning through design, construction, delivery and close-out, we execute a proven process to minimize your costs and maximize value and speed-to-market.
- [Public Institutions Project & Program Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/project-and-program-management/public-institutions-project-and-program-management): Full-service design, engineering, program management and construction management for your public sector projects.
- [Retail Investor Project & Program Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/project-and-program-management/retail-investor-project-and-program-management): Our Retail Project Management team provides development management, construction management and tenant Coordination services for owners, investors and developers of shopping centers.
- [Retail Occupier Project & Program Management](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/project-and-program-management/retail-occupier-project-and-program-management): We work across all phases of store and shopping center delivery: due diligence, design, schedule, permit, construction exhibit negotiations, entitlement, construction and closeout.
- [Workplace Technology](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/project-and-program-management/workplace-technology): how CBRE transforms offices with technology design and project management services.
- [Supply Chain Advisory | Industrial & Logistics](https://www.cbre.com/services/design-and-build/supply-chain-sourcing): We help clients solve complex business problems and build distinct advantage through supply chain transformations.

## Services — Invest, Finance & Value

- [Invest in Commercial Real Estate](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value): As the global commercial real estate brokerage leader, CBRE is your strategic partner across the entire real estate investment lifecycle.
- [Capital Markets](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/capital-markets): Combining investment sales, advisory, financing and investment banking into a single, fully integrated global service offering for all property types.
- [Capital Markets Conversations](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/capital-markets/capital-markets-conversations): Welcome to Capital Markets Conversations, where top industry experts discuss today's most pressing topics and trends. In these quick-hitting monthly videos, CBRE research and transaction professionals come together to share timely insights and on-the-ground intelligence to inform your decisions.
- [Data Center Capital Markets](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/capital-markets/data-center-capital-markets): We provide transactional experience and technical expertise to support the underwriting and decision making of data center investors, operators and enterprises globally.
- [Debt & Structured Finance](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/capital-markets/debt-and-structured-finance): Debt & Structured Finance offers clients assistance with placement of debt and equity for all major property types.
- [Capital Solutions & Restructuring](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/capital-markets/debt-and-structured-finance/capital-solutions-and-restructuring): We restructure, rebalance and mend capital stacks, creating bespoke solutions for private and institutional owners, corporations and lenders.
- [Loan & Portfolio Sales](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/capital-markets/debt-and-structured-finance/loan-and-portfolio-sales): CBRE Loan & Portfolio Sales develop and execute loan sale strategies and solutions for commercial real estate and mortgage loan portfolios across all asset types and markets.
- [Loan Services](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/capital-markets/debt-and-structured-finance/loan-services): From our offices around the globe, we manage connections between our investor clients and their customers, providing exceptional outcomes for both.
- [Private Client Lending](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/capital-markets/debt-and-structured-finance/private-client-lending): CBRE's Private Client Lending group provides a direct-lending platform that originates commercial real estate loans from $1 million to $20 million.
- [Investment Banking](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/capital-markets/investment-banking): CBRE offers solutions for real estate clients across the spectrum of investment banking activities, public and private capital advisory and strategic advisory services.
- [Commercial Real Estate Investment Properties](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/capital-markets/investment-properties): CBRE Property Sales offers customized investment dispositions, acquisition and recapitalization services, together with market intelligence, to provide our clients with unmatched exposure to buyers.
- [Corporate Capital Markets](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/corporate-capital-markets): Providing unbiased advice, analysis, and execution capabilities for alternative capital solutions for corporately owned and occupied real estate.
- [Commercial Real Estate Market Forecasts and Analytics](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/market-forecasts-and-analytics): CBRE's Global Forecasting platform delivers commercial real estate data, market analysis, and forecasts across 250+ markets to inform investment decisions.
- [Strategic Investment Consulting](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/strategic-investment-consulting): Bespoke analysis to help you make confident decisions, attract more capital, enhance asset performance and drive value for your business.
- [Valuation & Advisory Services](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/valuation-and-advisory): CBRE provides comprehensive valuation, advisory and consulting services for real estate owners, investors and lenders.
- [Data Center Valuations](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/valuation-and-advisory/data-center-valuations): Leverage our global scale, consultative approach, and keen focus on local market trends to value your properties across all geographies.
- [Institutional Valuation and Advisory](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/valuation-and-advisory/institutional-valuation-and-advisory): We provide Fund Valuations for a wide range of institutional investors, including private real estate funds, public REITs, private equity firms and hedge funds. Our centralized team has extensive experience serving institutional investors, with expertise across core and alternative property types.
- [National ALTA/NSPS Land Surveys and Zoning Compliance](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/valuation-and-advisory/land-surveying-and-zoning): Providing full-scale land services including ALTA/NSPS surveys and zoning compliance for commercial real estate investors and lenders.
- [Portfolio Valuation & Advisory Services](https://www.cbre.com/services/invest-finance-and-value/valuation-and-advisory/portfolio-valuation-and-advisory-services): Our portfolio valuation services are integrated across a national platform and informed by CBRE’s unmatched access to data and extensive local market expertise.

## Services — Transform Business Outcomes

- [Transform Business Outcomes](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes): As the leader in global commercial real estate services, we harness our scale and expertise to support our diverse client types.
- [Adaptive Reuse](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/adaptive-reuse): Our entire team of experts work together towards one vision: to realize your asset’s full potential with speed and agility for all intended uses.
- [Consulting](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/consulting): Our consultants help occupiers and investors realize business potential through comprehensive, executable real estate strategies that optimize cost, enhance performance, elevate experiences and streamline operations.
- [Healthcare Consulting](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/consulting/healthcare-consulting): Expert healthcare guidance elevates operations, develops efficiencies across the care continuum, ensuring improved outcomes throughout your facility.
- [Labor Analytics](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/consulting/labor-analytics): Our experienced advisory and real estate professionals deploy distinctive skill sets and unprecedented analytic capacity to deliver superior results for clients.
- [Location Incentives](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/consulting/location-incentives): CBRE’s site selection and incentives services help clients make more informed location strategy decisions and reduce costs by securing economic incentives.
- [Location Intelligence](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/consulting/location-intelligence): Our team understands the potential of Geographic Information Systems (GIS), leveraging intelligence and technology to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients.
- [Portfolio Technology](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/consulting/portfolio-technology): Unlock superior portfolio and asset performance with technologies and strategic insights, enhancing your property investment decisions and workplace experience.
- [CAD/BIM Records Management & Drawing Services](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/consulting/portfolio-technology/cad-bim-records-management-drawing-services): CBRE works with clients to develop a defined records management program that enables effective portfolio management, operational efficiency, risk reduction and cost savings by ensuring building information is uploaded and accurately reflecting onsite coniditons. Our dedidcated team provides a range of services including CAD/CAFM support, as-built management, and drawing and design support.
- [Data Intelligence](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/consulting/portfolio-technology/data-intelligence): CBRE Data Intelligence transforms complex, fragmented real estate data into trusted, AI‑ready insights that drive measurable business impact.
- [IWMS Software Implementation and Administration Services](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/consulting/portfolio-technology/iwms-software-implementation-and-administration-services): CBRE offers end-to-end Integrated Workplace Management System (IWMS) solutions, empowering you to optimize your real estate portfolio, streamline operations, deliver space planning efficiently, and create a more engaging workplace experience.
- [Productivity Tech](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/consulting/portfolio-technology/productivity-tech): CBRE’s Productivity Technology Services empower organizations to unlock efficiency and innovation across Corporate Real Estate and beyond.
- [Technology Advisory Services](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/consulting/portfolio-technology/technology-advisory-services): There is no “one size fits all” when it comes to workplace technology. Our focus is on driving digital transformation by helping our clients select, implement and support the right suite of technology products to support their evolving workplace, changing portfolio and employee expectations.
- [Supply Chain Advisory](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/consulting/supply-chain-advisory): Solving complex business problems through supply chain transformations.
- [The Consulting Group](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/consulting/the-consulting-group): Formed over 30 years ago to address complex real estate and occupancy issues, The Consulting Group works with clients to match occupancy strategies with their business performance and financial goals.
- [Full Spectrum Lab Services](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/lab-services): Maximize efficiency, reliability and cost savings with CBRE's Full Spectrum Lab Services: OEM instrument repair, project management, data integration.
- [Cloud-Based Food & Beverage Monitoring](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/lab-services/food-and-beverage-monitoring): Safeguard perishable goods within cold storage environments and cold chain industries with professional cloud-based monitoring.
- [Full Spectrum Academy](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/lab-services/full-spectrum-academy): learning and development for your lab.
- [Lab Asset Management Services](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/lab-services/lab-asset-management-service): Create high-functioning, productive lab environments with a single-point solution covering all laboratory operational needs.
- [Dependable Lab Depot Repair Services](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/lab-services/lab-depot-repair-service): Save time and reduce costs with mail-in lab OEM equipment repair services performed by qualified experts.
- [Lab Equipment Qualification Services](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/lab-services/lab-equipment-qualification-services): Minimize data errors and maintain compliance throughout an instrument's lifecycle with comprehensive IQ/OQ/PQ qualification.
- [Lab Equipment Repair](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/lab-services/lab-equipment-repair-services): Simplify lab operations with flexible, on-demand or contract-based multi-vendor equipment repair services.
- [Autoclave Repair & Sterilizer Maintenance Programs](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/lab-services/lab-equipment-repair-services/autoclave-repair-services): Preserve laboratory research and operational integrity with expert autoclave and sterilizer instrument repair from CBRE.
- [Dissolution Tester Services](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/lab-services/lab-equipment-repair-services/dissolution-tester-repair): Keep critical dissolution testers in rotation with complete compliance and maintenance solutions from CBRE.
- [Lyophilizer & Freeze Dryer Repair Services](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/lab-services/lab-equipment-repair-services/freeze-dryer-repair-services): Optimize lyophilizer performance and reliability with CBRE’s thermal repair solutions.
- [Gas Chromatography Repair Service](https://www.cbre.com/services/transform-business-outcomes/lab-services/lab-equipment-repair-services/gas-chromatography-repair-service): CBRE's quick, reliable repair services minimize GC equipment downtime.
